dataset.scale_dtype: IEEE754 binary16 little endian, one per32 K values
dataset.weight_source: initial synthetic format-conformant data; actual artifact optional separate future dataset, never silently called the same as TS GGUF Q6

input.dtype: finite FP32 device input, RNE to BF16 inside both timed complete pipelines
input.accepted_BF16: finite normal or signedzero only; BF16 subnormal activations explicitly reject
input.scales: any finite binary16 including signedzero/subnormal/sign edges; NaN and Inf explicitly reject
input.invalid: bad sizes/strides/overflow, nonfinite inputs/cast/output/reference or unsupported BF16-subnormal input reject before performance qualification

reference.primary: independent literal FP64 signedcode*storedhalfscale*roundedBF16activation, sequential K order, also full sumAbs
reference.secondary: independent FP32 SIMT scalar group32 dot, storedhalfscale and final BF16, functionality/same-dtype performance baseline only, not fastest Ignis baseline
reference.small: all CPU FP64/FP32 outputs cross-check device reference; full arrays persisted
reference.real: full GPU FP64 and sumAbs reference persisted for all T*vocab

candidate.method: independently written TensorSharp-owned BF16 PTX MMA m16n8k16; exact signed-int8 toBF16 conversion; group32 F32 accumulate then halfscale; fixed shared CTA split reduction; final RNE BF16

fixed_error_gate.n: G+64, covering32-term dot/group and atmostG accumulation plus<=32-way reduction
fixed_error_gate.source: forward F32 rounding bound plus BF16 RNE relative and underflow bounds, not fitted to observed outputs
fixed_error_gate.exact_subset: integer/power-of-two small cases with exact representable F32 accumulation must match expected finalBF16 bits exactly
fixed_error_gate.AA: each identical device path full BF16 output repeated bitwise0 tolerance

quality_guard.layout: independent CPU roundtrip/offset proof, codes/scales/gaps/padding guards and deliberate index/scale/code mutations rejected
quality_guard.writes: dual output poisons, all guards and every output persisted; no impossible-sentinel assumption
quality_guard.argmax: same BF16 output host strict-first-max diagnostic; no hidden equivalence to original F32 Q6 logits, fullmodel/CUA NOT_RUN

timing.primary: same W8 data: device FP32→BF16 cast + matmul + final BF16 store, SIMT vs owned TC
timing.pattern: ABBA, everyhalf full output gate, fixed input perpair
timing.warm: same matrix repeated with explicit iterations; all required stages inside events
timing.sweep: >=2*driverL2 volatile full-read+checksum control before each half, event-excluded/synchronized, iterations1; all-data, not physicalcold guarantee
timing.excluded: validation FP64 reference/copy/serialization only, not any inference cast/format work
timing.matmul_only_or_argmax: only separately named optional diagnostics; not silently used as primary
timing.Q6: separate context only, never same-quality/same-engine speedup
timing.official_strong_baseline: future unchanged Apache e600 W8 closure if separately packaged/attributed; naive SIMT is not a leader proxy

storage.success: all small+real reference.f64, sumAbs.f64, SIMT.bf16, TC.bf16 in owned /dev/shm data; no FUSE writes during measure; archive only afterprocesscomplete
storage.ELF: physically executable /root/artifacts, budget preflight with301MiB currentRootfree

licensing.implementation: owned source independently authored from public PTX/format specification, no Ignis code copied
licensing.references: pinned e600a7d9e0d5921d767a6cb464373583b3cdcaf4 source and source-capture-manifest ec1087fe24bc4652d506921555b4acb241dcb4905f075a8fb1b04729a8bad89a; source notices retained if later external baseline copied

production.promotion: only after actual numeric, complete-cost benefit, memory and realmodel perquestion no-regression gates
